Reserved, Protected and Unclassed Forests: share of forest land, meaning and states. Class 10 Geography, Forest and Wildlife Resources, explained.

• Reserved: more than half of India's forest land, most valuable for conservation
• Protected: almost one-third, protected from further depletion
• Unclassed: other forests and wastelands, high in the North-eastern states
• Reserved plus protected are permanent forest estates; Madhya Pradesh has the largest area
